dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's how it is. You know what? I think that what this needs is an even more daring hypothesis!

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: I'm a scholar from Sumeru, and I'm currently researching Watatsumi Island's culture and history.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: I was here before the Sakoku Decree was declared, and I have remained here till now. In this time, I have discovered huge differences between Watatsumi Island and Narukami Island.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: For example, have a look at this totem that I dug up from ruins in the wild. Studying these lines and patterns has led me to a marvelous conclusion!

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Ha, my conclusions must be correct!

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: My conclusion is that ancient Inazuma must have played host to two snake gods!

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: One of them was enjoined with coral and could not move, thus creating Sangonomiya Shrine. Its true divine form dwelled within Enkanomiya deep below, forever defending the people of Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: As for the other snake god, it was a most ambitious being that dreamed of invading Narukami Island, but was cut down by the Electro Archon as it was making its way there.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: See? This totem shows snake patterns with coral on them on one end, and patterns that completely lack them on the other. And that's how you know this is the truth!

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Very reasonable, is it not? Once I publish my conclusions, I'll be famous! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you sure of your conclusions?

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: Of course. A researcher must always persist in their views. For instance, it doesn't matter how much everyone thinks that Mondstadt only has The Four Winds. Well, I reckon that there are five!

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: That shrine maiden at the Sangonomiya Shrine may shake her head at my conclusions, but it is she who has been blinded by her faith.

dialogues.speaker: Kaushik
dialogues.text: I mean, it's not like she has any evidence to show me herself, does she?
